_comment: REFERENCE ONLY. This file documents the catalog data shape for a possible future dynamic build (e.g. if a payment system is added). It is NOT fetched or rendered by any page. The live catalog is hardcoded in supplies.html and this file is kept in sync by hand. Prices and descriptions are real client data. SKUs are sequential placeholders, not real client SKUs. Note: item-003/item-004 (Hot Dog Container, 125ct/500ct), item-005/item-022 (1-Compartment, 200ct/100ct), item-006/item-023 (3-Compartment, 200ct/100ct), item-011/item-024 (Foam Food Container, 1,000ct case/single pack), item-026/item-027 (Wax Paper, box/case) and item-032/item-033 (Paper Towel, single roll/case) are each two rows here (one per SKU/pack size), but supplies.html renders each pair as a single merged card with two stacked prices -- a deliberate Phase 1 display exception, not a data mismatch to fix. New rows (item-022 onward) are appended at the end rather than inserted near their siblings, to keep existing SKUs/ids stable. supplies.html's #1-#33 display numbering is a separate, independent scheme from these ids/skus -- see the note above the catalog section in supplies.html.
